dsh-permission-guard
A Permission Settings page for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
One page under **Settings** that does two things:

- **New-session default** — one button makes every session created from then on start in
**Full acce

ss**; a second button restores the safe *Workspace write* default.
- **Existing-session allowlist**

— sessions that already exist keep their own permission.
You can raise one of them to Full access, o
ne session at a time.
The page asks for confirmation before enabling Full access, and names the risk in plain words.
## Install
**Plugin market** — once listed, install it from **Settings → Plugins** in the app.

**Today, from this repository** (the CLI adds the package to your profile and registers its
bundle i

m this repository** (the CLI adds the package to your profile and registers its
bundle in one step):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Swap `desktop` for your own profile name if it differs. A pinned tarball works the same way:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Reload the window afterwards. The page appears under **Settings → Permissions** (权限设置).
## What it actually does
This plugin does not invent a permission system. It writes the permission presets DSH already has:

- the **new-session default** is the `defaultPreset` value of the `permission` settings
namespace, w

hich DSH reads when it creates a session. Changing it never touches a session
that already exists.
-

an **allowlist entry** performs the same preset write as the `/permission` command, so the
change i
s recorded in that one session's own log and survives a restart.

Full access means sandbox `danger-full-access` with approval policy `never`: no confirmation
prompts
, and writes to any file the DSH process can reach.
## Why a page instead of a dropdown

DSH ships a single "permission" row in **Settings → General**. This plugin gives the same write
a de

dicated page with the two operations people actually asked for: one switch for everything
new, and a
per-session list for everything old.
## Requirements

- DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** or newer (desktop app and `dsh web` both work).
- The standard `settings` and `

permission-presets` plugins, which every standard composition
includes.
